news.headline: Sources: Patriots fear Drake Maye has broken ankle, could miss rest of season
news.description: The Patriots are concerned that Drake Maye fractured his ankle, sources told ESPN, an injury that could sideline the star QB for the rest of the season.

news.headline: Joe Burrow's 4-TD night puts QB in company of Tom Brady, Peyton Manning
news.description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions Sunday night, becoming just the third player in NFL history after Tom Brady and Peyton Manning to throw at least 20 passing touchdowns in a five-game span.

news.headline: Five reasons why Chargers' offense, Justin Herbert have struggled in 2026 season
news.description: Are injuries the biggest reason behind the Chargers' offensive struggles? Are Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton both taking steps back? We looked at the tape for answers.

news.headline: Aaron Rodgers' 2026 NFL season: Tracking records, milestones
news.description: The Pittsburgh passer is chasing records in his 22nd NFL season, and ESPN is chronicling his "last rodeo."

news.description: Big-time offensive plays highlight top NFL plays of Week 10

news.headline: 49ers put up big numbers vs. Cowboys, tout 'incredibly dangerous' offense
news.description: The 49ers racked up 584 yards against the Cowboys on Sunday in a jaw-dropping offensive display led by Brock Purdy, Christian McCaffrey and Deebo Samuel.

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate Sunday
news.description: Christian McCafffrey, Jahmyr Gibbs and Patrick Mahomes put fantasy teams on their back in Week 10, while Jonathan Taylor and the Packers and Panthers' passing games had quiet days.

news.headline: Burrow throws 4 TDs as Bengals blow out Steelers
news.description: Burrow throws 4 TDs as Bengals blow out Steelers 38-18

news.headline: Aaron Rodgers makes fantasy football history, now No. 2 on all-time scoring list
news.description: With Aaron Rodgers' score on Sunday, he reaches another fantasy football accolade in his HOF-worthy career.

news.headline: Browns' Deshaun Watson relishes 'special' win vs. Texans after engineering rally
news.description: Deshaun Watson, who delivered his sixth game-winning drive of the season, called the 27-24 victory over the Texans, his former team, "definitely special."

news.headline: Patrick Mahomes stars for Chiefs, strikes early connection with Josh Downs
news.description: Even with an elbow injury, Patrick Mahomes was able to have his best performance of the year to lead the Chiefs to a dominant 35-13 win over the Falcons.

news.headline: Aaron Donald savors first sack in 1,050 days, but Rams' win 'felt even better'
news.description: Aaron Donald recorded his first sack since New Year's Eve in 2023 and helped the Rams top the Cardinals for their fourth straight win.

news.headline: Kirk Cousins emotional after win in Vikings return, reflects on 'tough 3 years'
news.description: Kirk Cousins was emotional discussing his return to the Vikings after their victory over the Packers.

news.description: Jordan Love and the Packers expressed their frustration after a 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
